visual_description: The image displays a pyramid-shaped diagram composed of ten blue rectangular blocks arranged in four horizontal tiers, each labeled with a step number and descriptive text. The base tier contains Steps 1 through 4: “Assess the Target Population,” “Perform a Self-Assessment,” “Develop a Niche,” and “Develop Program Outcomes.” The second tier from the bottom includes Steps 5–7: “Develop a Shared Vision,” “Develop Strategic Goals and Objectives,” and “Develop the Strategic Plan.” The third tier holds Steps 8 and 9: “Develop the Implementation Plan” and “Develop the Evaluation Plan.” The apex block is Step 10: “Implement the Strategies and Evaluate Progress.” All text is white on blue backgrounds, centered within each block, and clearly legible. No axes, charts, tables, or numerical data are present.
